project_overview.name: AYANA Care Platform - Functional & Design Blueprint
project_overview.description: Incremental functional fixes and component blueprints for AYANA React App. Preserves existing visual identity (warm cream, emerald/coral accents, tailwind + shadcn primitives) while resolving timing sync bugs, unifying Check-ins with inline replies & voice notes, enforcing mandatory fields, restructuring care setup into 4 explicit sections, and streamlining activation.

surface_and_elevation.cards: bg-white rounded-[16px] border border-[#efe8d8] p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-[0_1px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]
surface_and_elevation.containers: bg-[#faf6ec] rounded-xl border border-[#efe8d8] p-3 sm:p-4

1_unified_checkins_and_accurate_replies.problem_addressed: Discrepancy in check-in vs reply timing where dad's afternoon/reengagement reply matched morning check-in state, plus redundant separate 'Replies' tab.

solution_design.tab_consolidation: Remove separate Replies inbox tab / page. Merge all reply text, audio voice messages, and status timelines directly into Check-ins tab on Dashboard.js.
solution_design.parent_and_date_filtering: Allow parent tab selection (Mom vs Dad) and date selector (week strip + month calendar modal). Filter check-ins and replies accurately by parent ID and date ISO.
solution_design.accurate_message_mapping: Map incoming WhatsApp replies to the exact category/time item (e.g. afternoon lunch vs morning wish/medicines) using reply intent / schedule_message_id rather than falling back to default first slot.
solution_design.audio_player: Embed native HTML5 audio element or custom waveform voice player inside check-in items when reply contains audio_url / is_voice=true.

2_four_care_sections_restructuring.problem_addressed: Cluttered or ambiguous care schedule form in ParentCareForm.jsx and Onboarding.js.

sections.title: Medicines
fields: Shape (round, oval, capsule, oblong, diamond, square)
Color (white, cream, yellow, orange, pink, red, purple, blue, green, brown, beige)
sections.requirement: Medicine shape and color MUST be included in the reminder payload sent to parent.

sections.title: Safety check
fields: From where / Location label (e.g. Evening walk at park, Market return, Home stay-alone check)

3_mandatory_cities_validation.child_city: Mandatory in Onboarding Step 0 (Child profile) and Account panel.
3_mandatory_cities_validation.parent_city: Mandatory in Onboarding Step 2 and ParentCareForm.

4_activation_flow_cleanup.problem_addressed: Remove direct parent chat opening button ('open amma') to avoid confusing activation trigger.
4_activation_flow_cleanup.solution_design: Activation page (/activation) now exclusively features child activation confirmation, setup guidance, training video link, and back-to-dashboard navigation. No direct 'Open WhatsApp for parent' action.

dashboard_page.instructions: Consolidate CheckinsTab. Include parent filter tabs, date picker, accurate check-in cards with inline reply text, voice note audio controls, and status badges (Sent, Replied, Child Notified). Remove 'Replies inbox' tab.

parent_care_form.instructions: Update care schedule layout into 4 explicit sections: 1. Daily check-ins, 2. Daily Activities, 3. Medicines (with mg/qty, time, shape, color, instruction), 4. Safety check (days mon-sun, time, location). Enforce parent city validation.

onboarding_page.instructions: Make child city and parent city required. Align step 2 with 4 care sections. Update step 3 activation to be child-only confirmation.

activation_page.instructions: Clean activation guidance page. Remove direct parent WhatsApp chat triggers.

replies_page.instructions: Redirect or embed inside Dashboard check-ins section.

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, selects, tabs, audio controls) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Preserve all existing visual styling (colors, borders, fonts, spacing, shadcn dialogs/tabs).
Ensure responsive layout for both mobile and desktop viewports.
Add data-testid to all newly added form fields and interactive elements.
Do not import or render missing image URLs; use existing Lucide icons and clean Tailwind surfaces.
